articles.summary: Geraldine C Edu, Karin J Stebbins, Alexander R Broadhead, Michael M Poon, Ariana O Lorenzana, Thomas Schrader, Yifeng Xiong, Jill Baccei, Ari J Green, Jonah R Chan, and Daniel S Lorrain Presented at Neuroscience 2019 The post The muscarinic M1 antagonist PIPE-359 demonstrates remyelination in vivo through visual evoked potential (VEP) and electron microscopy (EM) of mice with experimental autoimmune encephalitis (EAE) first appeared on Contineum Therapeutics .
articles.title: The muscarinic M1 antagonist PIPE-359 demonstrates remyelination in vivo through visual evoked potential (VEP) and electron microscopy (EM) of mice with experimental autoimmune encephalitis (EAE)
